raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step ignores the currency column, so 85 EUR-denominated amounts are summed as if they were USD in every gold total. raw_fx_rates supplies a rate_to_usd for EUR (1.25, as of 2026-01-01), so the amounts can be converted to USD in silver; this uses the only rate available for all dates.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.75, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CAST(t.amount AS DOUBLE) * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = t.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED'"}}
